title: voice.cast.completed.v1
description: Published when TTS audio has been successfully cast to a Chromecast/Google Home device.

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the Chromecast/Google Home device.

device_name.description: Friendly name of the target device.

audio_url.description: URL of the synthesized audio that was cast.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the audio in milliseconds.

engine.description: TTS engine used for synthesis (kokoro, f5-tts, etc.).
